Austin, TX

IBM is hiring an Entry Level Cloud Developer for its Cloud Network Services team. The role contributes to developing and operating IBM Cloud DNS and NTP infrastructure services, with work spanning implementation, testing, automation, production operations, and service reliability.

Responsibilities
Design and develop enhancements for IBM Cloud DNS and NTP services, translating functional and operational requirements into technical solutions
Implement, test, and maintain service components, automation, and tooling using modern software engineering practices
Build and execute unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure service quality, reliability, and performance
Collaborate with DevOps and CI/CD teams to automate build, validation, deployment, and release processes
Support the compliance, security, and operational integrity of production cloud environments
Participate in observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident response activities to help meet service reliability objectives
Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Networking, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve service resiliency
Contribute to technical documentation, operational runbooks, and continuous improvement initiatives
Participate in code reviews and team discussions to learn best practices and contribute to engineering excellence
Continuously develop technical skills and gain exposure to cloud-native technologies, networking concepts, and distributed systems

Required
Bachelor's Degree
Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Networking, or a related technical field
Experience through coursework, projects, internships, or research in software development, cloud technologies, networking, or distributed systems
Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Go, Python, Bash
Familiarity with infrasructure as code or orchestration tools like Terraform or Ansible
Working knowledge of Linux operating systems, preferably Ubuntu and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, NTP, routing, load balancing, and troubleshooting concepts
Familiarity with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Exposure to source control, automated testing, and CI/CD development practices
Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills
Demonstrated ownership, teamwork, adaptability, and a passion for learning and technology
in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship
Preferred
Experience with cloud platforms, cloud-native applications, or infrastructure services
Knowledge of large-scale DNS architectures, time synchronization services, and highly available distributed systems
Familiarity with engineering and operational tools such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow
Exposure to infrastructure automation, configuration management, and platform engineering practices
Understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident management processes
Awareness of security, compliance, and reliability best practices in cloud environments
Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools and applying AI capabilities across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including coding, testing, documentation, and operational support
Interest in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud networking, and scalable platform services
Benefits
Eligible employees may have access to healthcare benefits including medical & prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, and mental health & well being.
Eligible employees may have access to financial programs such as 401(k), cash balance pension plan, the IBM Employee Stock Purchase Plan, financial counseling, life insurance, short & long-term disability coverage, and opportunities for performance based salary incentive programs.
Generous paid time off including 12 holidays, minimum 56 hours sick time, 120 hours vacation, 12 weeks parental bonding leave in accordance with IBM Policy, and other Paid Care Leave programs.
IBM also offers paid family leave benefits to eligible employees where required by applicable law.
Training and educational resources on our personalized, AI-driven learning platform where IBMers can grow skills and obtain industry-recognized certifications to achieve their career goals.
Diverse and inclusive employee resource groups, giving & volunteer opportunities, and discounts on retail products, services & experiences.
